transport_help: How the server talks to the device on port 4370. Use UDP if every operation (push, sync, enrol) is very slow over TCP — some firmware answers each TCP command 5–10 s late. Switch back to TCP if the device stops responding over UDP.
transport_saved_udp: Now talking to the device over UDP
transport_saved_tcp: Now talking to the device over TCP
title: Device Security
comm_key_help: Authenticates the server to the device on TCP 4370. Once set it is never shown again — only whether one is configured.
restrict_intro: Restrict <mono>{{sn}}</mono> to pushing attendance only from these addresses. Leave the check off for sites on a dynamic IP.
cidrs_help: Comma separated. A bare address means that address only.
